description: Deterministic edit: shorten a layer, committed immediately. Either a relative trim (edge "start" | "end" + seconds to remove) or an absolute range in TIMELINE seconds (start_time + end_time: the part of the layer's current window to keep). On a single-source cut timeline the trim ripples later segments closed. A trim that removes nothing is an error (NO_CHANGE).

layer_id.description: Id of the layer to trim.

project_id.description: Project whose committed scene is edited.

seconds.description: [relative] Seconds to remove from that edge (> 0).

name: trim_layer
title: Trim layer
